text:
olivia: quick heads-up — saw a few tickets where API keys used by shared CI pipelines show up as \"unknown\" in console, so quota attribution and owner links are broken
kevin: yep noticed billing spike. telemetry shows many requests with no project_id in the envelope :/
sam: is this the pipeline not setting origin headers or something else?
maria: often the pipeline runs under a shared project key; some exchanges strip org claim when exchanging to ephemeral sa tokens
ashley: console UX is bad here — users see \"unattributed\" and can't click through to claim the key. we should show an \"inferred owner\" state with a tooltip
lee: for attribution heuristics i suggest precedence: X-Redwood-Origin header > key metadata owner > exchange_history.provenance > fallback: unauthenticated
kevin: agree. also need a confidence score (high/med/low) so billing + alerts can treat low-confidence differently
olivia: can we include a small header from token-exchange: \"X-RW-Origin-Provenance: exchange=project:123;confidence=low\"?
sam: if token-exchange adds that, we can wire it through auth-proxy and tag requests. curl example we can use in docs:

```bash
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \\
     -H \"X-Redwood-Origin: project/123\" \\
     https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

maria: fallback rules in pseudocode:

```text
if header.origin: use header
elif key.owner: use key.owner
elif exchange.provenance: use exchange.owner (confidence from exchange)
else: mark unattributed
```

ashley: for console change: show owner chip + small chevron that expands into \"inferred from header (confidence: low) — claim key\" link. claim flow should open modal to reassign key to project
lee: telemetry: add tags `origin_inferred`, `origin_confidence`, and `origin_source` to request metrics. also emit `attribution_fallback_rate` gauge for alerts
kevin: rollout plan proposal: 1) implement server-side tagging in auth-proxy (canary 5%) 2) backfill attribution for last 7 days job 3) UI + claim flow 4) enable billing reconciliation flag
olivia: dev-bot — canary for auth-proxy v1.12 please? :pray:
dev-bot: scheduled deploy: auth-proxy v1.12 -> canary 5% at 2023-11-15T09:00Z :rocket:
ashley: also want an alert: when unattributed traffic > 1% of total for 15m and rps > 1000, paged to eng-platform oncall
sam: +1, add dashboard slice `Auth Attribution: confidence breakdown` and a table for top keys with `unattributed_count`
maria: edge case: cross-tenant exchanges where exchange.provenance says project A but final usage billed to project B — we should tag both and surface conflict in UI
lee: logging snippet we can add to auth-proxy for debug mode:

```json
{\"req_id\":\"$REQ\",\"origin_inferred\":\"project/123\",\"confidence\":\"low\",\"path\":\"/v1/generate\"}
```

olivia: sounds actionable. i'll open a small RFC PR with the precedence rules, telemetry keys, and UI mockups. want volunteers for review?
kevin: i'll review the telemetry + billing bits
maria: i'll drive the exchange change and add the origin_provenance header in the token service
sam: i'll spin up the dashboard slice after tagging is in prod
ashley: i'll prototype the claim modal
olivia: thanks team — will land RFC today and tag you all :thumbsup:
